title: VERA-MH: Reliability and Validity of an Open-Source AI Safety Evaluation in Mental Health
reasoning: The paper presents and validates the VERA-MH benchmark, where 'VERA' stands for the 'Validation of Ethical and Responsible AI'. The evaluation framework explicitly benchmarks the ethical performance and safety of AI chatbots in mental health contexts, including dimensions such as following AI boundaries and guiding users to human care.
